SELECT count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_line_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_receipt_line,
       sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff_rows,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN s.store_id END) nonphys_stores, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonphys_rows,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_rows,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg,
       max(f.etl_loaded_at) last_load, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rcpts, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, store_id)) rcpts_store, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, sale_date)) rcpts_date,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)) mixed_staff
FROM l

SELECT cs.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) cnet, SUM(receipts) cr FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stores, sum(a.net) wh_net, sum(c.cnet) ctl_net, sum(a.r) wh_rcpts, sum(c.cr) ctl_rcpts,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(a.net-c.cnet)>0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) store_gaps, sum(CASE WHEN a.r<>c.cr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rcpt_gaps
FROM a FULL JOIN c USING (store_id)
